title: Error analysis for the approximation of a flow in deformable porous media with nonlinear strain-stress relation
summary: We study a model describing the slow flow of a fluid through a deformable, porous, elastic solid undergoing small deformations. The stress-strain relationship of the solid incorporates nonlinear effects, formulated as a perturbation of the classical linear elasticity. To approximate the coupled system, we introduce a discrete scheme based on a first order semi-implicit time integration scheme combined with a standard finite element spatial discretization.
